subject: Show login error message with LDAP

messages.author: ae36205664915f39
messages.subject: Show login error message with LDAP
parts:
I have shiny server pro connected to LDAP. When a user enters incorrect creds and submits, the login.html page just merely redirects back to itself after the 403 is returned from the POST. Some of my users get confused because there is no message on why the window is still the login.html page.

Is there an easy way to add an error message after the redirect? I know in .php we can store session variables then .show() a div if there is an error...can we do something similar with shiny session variables and the login.html page?

messages.author: ae36205664915f39
messages.subject: Re: Show login error message with LDAP
parts:
I was able to create a work-around solution where I check for the URL to contain "login" and show an error div if the URL contains it.

The logic is that when an app requires a group or user to load the URL is still the base URL of that application even though the login screen is what the user sees. Now if the user's form POST returns 403 then the redirected window is actually <base url>/__login__

So for most of my purposes the simple check below will show "incorrect username and/or password" if the login page is redirected to itself and thereby containing the string "login".

    if(window.location.href.indexOf("login") > -1) {
       $('div.loginerror').show()
    }

I am still interested in the answer to my first post though.
